<!-- Generated by `flusso schema docs` from the opensearch adapter's config type; edit the doc comments there, then run `just schema-gen`. -->
| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"opensearch"` | — | Required. Selects this adapter for `[sinks.<name>]`. |
| `url` | string or `{ env }` | — | Required. Base URL of the cluster, literal or `{ env = "VAR" }`. `<NAME>_OPENSEARCH_URL` overrides or supplies it. |
| `username` | string or `{ env }` | none | HTTP Basic auth user. `<NAME>_OPENSEARCH_USERNAME` overrides or supplies it. |
| `password` | string or `{ env }` | none | HTTP Basic auth password. `<NAME>_OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD` overrides or supplies it. |
| `tls_verify` | bool | `true` | Verify TLS certificates against the Mozilla root bundle built into flusso, plus `ca_file`; the OS trust store is not read. Set `false` for a local cluster with a self-signed certificate. |
| `ca_file` | string | none | A PEM bundle of CA certificates trusted on top of the built-in Mozilla roots, for a cluster behind a private CA. Read when the sink starts: a missing file, or one with no certificate, stops the start. A relative path is resolved against flusso's working directory. |
| `batch_size` | int | `1000` | Documents per bulk request. |
| `max_bytes` | int | `10485760` | Maximum serialized size of one bulk request, in bytes. A flush is split so no request exceeds this, independent of `batch_size`, keeping requests under OpenSearch's `http.max_content_length` (100 MB by default). A single document larger than this is sent on its own. |
| `timeout_secs` | int | `30` | Request timeout, in seconds. |
| `max_retries` | int | `3` | Retries for a transient failure of a whole bulk request. A refused TLS certificate is never retried. |
| `pipeline` | string | none | An ingest pipeline applied to every indexed document. |
| `number_of_shards` | int | `1` | Primary shards for each index flusso creates. |
| `number_of_replicas` | int | `1` | Replica shards for each index flusso creates. |
| `refresh_interval` | string | `"10s"` | The `refresh_interval` applied to each index once its backfill completes: the steady-state visibility ceiling (`"10s"`, `"1s"`, or `"-1"` to disable automatic refresh). Indexes are seeded with refresh off and handed this value afterwards; a flush that catches the pipeline up forces an immediate refresh, so this only bounds staleness while a backlog drains. With `"-1"`, that catching-up flush also refreshes what the backlog wrote. |
| `text_analysis` | `builtin` \| `icu` | `"builtin"` | Which analysis toolkit the built-in `flusso_*` analyzers use. |
| `auto_subfields` | bool | `true` | Whether `text`/`keyword` fields are enriched with a good analyzer and the `keyword` / `keyword_lowercase` / `text` subfields. A field's explicit mapping always wins. |
| `index_settings` | table | none | Extra OpenSearch index settings for every index this sink creates, e.g. `{ "mapping.total_fields.limit" = 5000 }`. Applied when an index generation is created. Keys, precedence, and the keys flusso owns are in the Sink: OpenSearch reference, under Index settings. |
